title: Choose Meard's visual world
question: The roll assigned Wire Harness Loom. Keep it, take a fused alternate, re-roll, steer, or play the category straight.

options.label: Wire Harness Loom
options.body: Meard’s mechanism made physical: color-coded conductors, pin maps, and loom tape as the site’s grammar. Local-first means every capability is a route you own—bundled, labeled, and self-hosted—not a cloud socket. First viewport: a full-width harness workbench with the blue M as the primary connector housing; left rail pin-table of lab truths; right, live-feeling conductor runs labeled Harness · Post-training · Your hardware. Primary action: pin-label CTAs Explore tools → GitHub and Contact. Honest risk: funders outside deep tech need one clear sentence so “harness” doesn’t read as jargon-only engineering porn.

options.label: Jacquard Punch Loom
options.lineage: Punched-instruction brocade → open tools that weave local capability
options.body: Midnight silk ground, gold weft motifs, cream punch-card rows. GitHub tools read as instruction cards; post-training is the gold bird that only appears when thousands of local choices fire. Gallery-grade for funders who fund craft + science. Craft bar is museum textile, not SaaS cards.

options.label: Detector Event Display
options.lineage: Collider event displays → research lab as instrument
options.body: Near-black vacuum, steel detector rings, cyan/yellow tracks as self-hosted request paths through Meard’s stack. Mission and tools present as one frozen event you can isolate track-by-track. Strong science-funder identification; risk is drifting into default “AI dark lab” unless tracks stay about local hardware routes, not vibes.
